title: Sharp constant problems for harmonic mappings
summary: The primary objective of this paper is to investigate sharp constant problems in harmonic Hardy spaces. We first establish a sharp asymptotic constant for a Littlewood-Paley type inequality applicable to weak harmonic $(K, K_0)$-quasiregular mappings, where $K \geq 1$ and $K_0 \geq 0$. Subsequently, we derive sharp Hardy-Littlewood type constants for harmonic mappings.
